atoms.text:
Several weeks later.

Of course, the competition was immediately cancelled. For the first time in Knut’s life, all the bridges were still standing during the month of June.

The McTroll family had been banished. Only little Forsythia was allowed to return for visits. It was revealed that the McTrolls had a deal with Daisy from the society. In return for her help, the profits from the competition would be shared between them. Apparently, the society had been helping the winners for a long time.
The society was dismantled. No longer would the bridges be judged by the society but rather by randomly chosen citizens.

A team of scientists got together and began studying the briars. How could they be controlled to prevent them from eating any more bridges? It seemed sugar and cement were the key, and new edible statues were being erected all over the city to give them something to eat other than the bridges. Who knows, maybe a new edible sculpture competition might begin!

It was decided that the bridge competition would continue. Trollaland was simply too fond of the yearly battle to give it up. It was decided though, that no bridge would be forced to fall down before a winner was declared. Each family happily pledged themselves to the new rules.

It really felt like a new tune was being played in Trollaland.

“Knut!” called his mother, “Come on, time to go check the bridge again!” Knut sighed. Some things hadn’t changed so much after all.

atoms.a: What was special about this June?
What happened to the Spanning Society, and how will the contest be judged next year?
b: ++They were abolished and normal citizens will judge the contest.
They were given more power and will continue judging the contest.
They all went on holiday and have no plans to ever come back.
They were collected and sent to Trolland to be studied in advanced research labs.
++New statues were built of cement and sugar to help control their bridge-eating habits.
They were officially declared to be a myth and nobody thought of them ever again.

atoms.a: What is meant by the metaphor “a new tune was being played”?
b: The trolls were learning to develop new technology.
The trolls were developing new musical talents.
++Things in Trollaland were beginning to change.
